result.edit: The test fails at cycle=3 with incorrect Gray code output (0010 vs expected 0011). The issue is in the Gray-to-binary conversion where bin_out[1] and bin_out[0] incorrectly depend on previous bin_out values instead of only gray_wire inputs. This creates a timing dependency. The fix changes the conversion to use only current gray_wire values for XOR operations, ensuring correct Gray code generation that matches the specification.
